decks.notes: The deck revolves around assembling a combo using Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game immediately. The deck aims to control the game early using disruption spells like Force of Will and Duress, while also digging through the deck with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder. Key cards like Ancestral Recall and Demonic Tutor help find the necessary pieces for the combo, while also generating card advantage. The deck is designed to be fast and efficient, utilizing powerful cards like Black Lotus and Necropotence to accelerate its game plan.

The deck focuses on using efficient spells to control the opponent's board and hand, while also utilizing various powerful mana sources and card draw options. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, removal like Fatal Push and Psychic Frog, and hand disruption with cards like Gitaxian Probe and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes powerful card advantage cards like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, as well as ways to recur key pieces like Lurrus of the Dream-Den.

This deck focuses on utilizing Bazaar of Baghdad to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Vengevine, Hollow One, and Squee, Goblin Nabob. By using powerful free spells like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Force of Vigor, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a fast aggressive strategy. The ability to consistently bring back creatures from the graveyard while controlling the board with cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine gives this deck a strong tempo advantage and the ability to overwhelm opponents quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing hatebears and aggressive creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. It also utilizes cards like Cavern of Souls and Chrome Mox to ensure efficient mana production for its creatures. Cards like Archon of Emeria and Anointed Peacekeeper provide additional disruption for the opponent, while cards like March of Otherworldly Light and White Plume Adventurer help maintain card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Wasteland and Chancellor of the Annex further disrupt the opponent's game plan, making it difficult for them to execute their strategy effectively.

The deck focuses on using counter spells, removal, and card advantage to control the opponent's threats while developing its own game plan. It utilizes powerful restricted cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain card advantage and extra turns, while also running efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Psychic Frog. The deck also uses disruptive creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Snapcaster Mage to pressure the opponent while still holding up counter magic. Overall, the deck aims to out-value the opponent and grind out a victory through control and resource management.

The key concept of this deck revolves around using a combination of disruption, card advantage, and mana efficiency to control the game while utilizing powerful spells and creatures to outvalue the opponent. This Dimir Control deck aims to dominate the opponent by countering threats, disrupting their game plan, and drawing cards efficiently. With a focus on controlling the board and manipulating the game to your advantage, this deck seeks to establish dominance and win through attrition and incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with cards such as Ichorid, Stinkweed Imp, and Golgari Thug, in order to bring back powerful creatures like Golgari Grave-Troll and Prized Amalgam. Utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to dig through the deck, players can execute explosive combos like Creeping Chill triggers and Hollow One plays. With a mix of disruptive elements like Force of Will and Force of Negation, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a relentless graveyard-based strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that also have hatebear abilities to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Stillmoon Cavalier with hatebears like Chancellor of the Annex and Anointed Peacekeeper, the deck aims to slow down the opponent while applying pressure. The deck also includes disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void and disruptive lands like Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive elements.

The core idea of this MUD aggro Vintage deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland, Strip Mine, and Ghost Quarter, while deploying powerful artifacts like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim, Nettlecyst, and Stonecoil Serpent. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Crucible of Worlds, while utilizing Mishra's Workshop to generate extra mana for explosive plays. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator and Mystic Forge provides additional versatility and card advantage, making it a strong and resilient aggro archetype in the Vintage format.

The main concept of this Vintage 1 vs 1 Bazaar Aggro deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla and Hollow One, to bring back powerful creatures like Vengevine and Master of Death. The deck utilizes Bazaar of Baghdad for card filtering and Noxious Revival for graveyard recursion. It also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap to control the game. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and efficient graveyard synergies while disrupting their game plan with disruptive spells like Force of Negation.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Dredge mechanic to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures and spells, allowing for powerful combos and synergies to be executed. By cycling cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, combined with cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder, the player is able to consistently bring back creatures like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam. Creeping Chill can provide additional damage, while Grief allows for disruption of the opponent's hand. The deck also includes various counterspells and protection cards to ensure its combo can go off smoothly.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful artifacts and spells to quickly assemble a winning combination involving Coveted Jewel. It aims to generate mana quickly with cards like Mishra's Workshop and Grim Monolith, while also controlling the game with cards like Force of Will and Tinker. The key strategy involves using Coveted Jewel's ability to gain an advantage over the opponent while also potentially generating a win condition. By utilizing a mix of powerful artifacts and efficient spells, the deck aims to create a dominant board state and ultimately achieve victory.

This deck focuses on assembling the Coveted Jewel combo as quickly as possible, using cards like Mishra's Workshop and Ancient Tomb to generate mana, and cards like Paradoxical Outcome to draw into key pieces. The deck also includes cards like Force of Will and Trinisphere to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect the combo. With access to powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk, as well as powerful artifacts like The One Ring and Time Vault, this deck aims to overpower the opponent and win the game quickly.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, and disruptive creatures like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade. The deck also utilizes card advantage with Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time, as well as powerful mana acceleration with Black Lotus and Moxen. The deck aims to control the game by interacting with and disrupting opponents' plays while eventually winning through incremental advantage or powerful late-game threats.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to generate a large amount of mana and cast a game-ending Tendrils of Agony. It utilizes powerful mana acceleration like Black Lotus and rituals, along with card draw and tutoring to find the combo pieces quickly. It also includes disruptive cards like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo from interaction. The deck is built to be efficient and fast, aiming to win the game before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing the graveyard as a resource to quickly fill the board with creatures like Stinkweed Imp, Narcomoeba, and Ichorid. Using cards like Creeping Chill and Prized Amalgam to deal damage and gain advantage. The deck aims to quickly combo off by dredging cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Golgari Thug, while also utilizing disruptive spells like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap to protect its game plan. Bazaar of Baghdad is used to fuel the graveyard and set up explosive turns.
